item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly prohibits specified imports, exports, reexports, transactions, investments, facilitation, and evasion by covered persons; the legal restrictions arise from the order itself on its stated effective dates rather than from a later agency decision.","evidence":"The following are prohibited"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorizes the Treasury Secretary, after consultation with State, to implement the order through actions, rules, reports, and delegated presidential powers, and permits redelegation; it does not dictate a particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"is hereby authorized to take such actions"},{"segment_id":"3","code":4,"rationale":"This inseparably combines discretionary agency implementation direction with an immediate, binding restriction on the Treasury Secretary's authority to grant certain export authorizations, so materially different postures appear in one segment.","evidence":"The Secretary of the Treasury may not authorize the exportation or reexportation"},{"segment_id":"4","code":4,"rationale":"This segment inseparably combines internal revocation and supplementation of prior orders, a non-rights disclaimer and explanatory statement, self-executing effective-date rules and temporary treatment of existing transactions, and a transmission/publication command.","evidence":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight time, on May 7, 1995"}]}
